list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia para interpretar cumplimiento de licencias y riesgos asociados.

options.content: Que muestra: estado de licencias por host, servicio, dominio y tecnologia. Como interpretarlo: NonCompliant, Unknown o Unverified requieren evidencia o remediacion; no son estado OK. Accion sugerida: priorizar hosts criticos y servicios afectados antes de auditorias o renovaciones.

panels.title: Resumen de Licencias
panels.description: Conteo de hosts por estado de licencia y cumplimiento para identificar brechas de auditoria.

targets.rawSql: select LicenseStatus, ComplianceStatus, count(*) as HostCount from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' group by LicenseStatus, ComplianceStatus order by case LicenseStatus when 'NonCompliant' then 1 when 'Unverified' then 2 when 'Unknown' then 3 else 4 end, ComplianceStatus

panels.title: Hosts y Evidencia de Licencia
panels.description: Detalle de hosts con estado de licencia, compliance y referencia directa a la evidencia cuando esta disponible.

targets.rawSql: select c.ComponentName as HostName, c.TechnologyType, c.DomainName, c.BusinessServiceId, c.Owner, c.LicenseStatus, c.ComplianceStatus, c.EvidenceState, coalesce(e.EvidenceReference, 'Sin evidencia disponible') as EvidenceReference, case when e.EvidenceReference is null then '#' else regexp_replace(e.EvidenceReference, '^https?://[^/]+', '') end as EvidencePath from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c left join EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e on e.ComponentId = c.ComponentId and e.LoadId = c.LoadId and e.EvidenceState = 'Available' where c.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by case c.LicenseStatus when 'NonCompliant' then 1 when 'Unverified' then 2 when 'Unknown' then 3 else 4 end, c.ComponentName

panels.title: Riesgos y Acciones de Licencia
panels.description: Riesgos de compliance asociados a licenciamiento con impacto y accion recomendada.

targets.rawSql: select r.Severity, c.ComponentName as HostName, c.LicenseStatus, c.ComplianceStatus, r.Impact, r.RecommendedAction, r.EvidenceState, coalesce(e.EvidenceReference, 'Sin evidencia disponible') as EvidenceReference, case when e.EvidenceReference is null then '#' else regexp_replace(e.EvidenceReference, '^https?://[^/]+', '') end as EvidencePath from EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = r.AffectedTechnologyId left join EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e on e.ComponentId = c.ComponentId and e.LoadId = c.LoadId and e.EvidenceState = 'Available' where r.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and r.RiskCategory = 'Compliance' order by case r.Severity when 'Critical' then 1 when 'High' then 2 when 'Medium' then 3 else 4 end, c.ComponentName
